name: Public Bank Berhad
overview: 2026年，Public Bank Berhad 的业务动态主要涉及一家全资子公司 PB Trust (L) Ltd 的解散，该子公司此前已启动成员自愿清盘。此外，公司宣布了2026年的中期股息派发安排。其他公告多为常规的公司治理、会议通知及季度业绩报告，未披露新的业务扩张、收缩或重大合约。
overview_en: In 2026, Public Bank Berhad's business developments mainly involved the dissolution of its wholly-owned subsidiary PB Trust (L) Ltd, which had previously commenced a members' voluntary winding-up. The company also announced interim dividend arrangements for 2026. Other announcements were mostly routine corporate governance, meeting notices, and quarterly results, with no disclosure of new business expansion, contraction, or major contracts.

segments.name: 其他金融服务
segments.note: 该板块下的信托服务子公司 PB Trust (L) Ltd 于2026年1月29日解散。
segments.note_en: PB Trust (L) Ltd, a subsidiary under this segment providing trustee services, was dissolved on 29 January 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 PB Trust (L) Ltd 在成员自愿清盘后于2026年1月29日解散。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary PB Trust (L) Ltd was dissolved on 29 January 2026 following a members' voluntary winding-up.
